name: 热敷揉捏U型颈椎按摩仪款
description: 揉捏+振动+恒温热敷+蓝牙音乐，U型记忆棉包裹肩颈

styleLock.backgroundSystem: warm cream #F2E9DD for hero and info screens, mist grey #E9E7E4 for mechanism screens, deep charcoal-navy #10141F for heat-feature and closing screens; soft 3D arched-niche geometry for display shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused warm studio light from front-left, gentle contact shadows, controlled warm glow accents on heating features, never harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cream podium disc and soft fabric-textured platforms, matte light-grey board
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons in single warm brown #A9836B, consistent rounded pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight front 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; product always centered-stable on podium or flat surface
styleLock.lockText: consistent warm comfort wellness-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm cream #F2E9DD, warm brown accent #A9836B, mist grey #E9E7E4 and charcoal text #2D2D2D; soft diffused warm studio lighting from the front-left with gentle contact shadows and controlled warm glow accents; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded pill labels and thin-line icons in warm brown; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight front 3/4 hero angle and product scale with every canvas composed edge to edge by podium geometry, glow accents and surface textures; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图
shots.camera: slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, the U-shaped product standing centered, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the product
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shown at a slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, centered and upright, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame; the seamless white field wraps it evenly on all sides. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

shots.intent: 一秒传达肩颈放松的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: straight-on front view, eye-level, product resting on a round podium inside a soft 3D arched niche
shots.lighting: soft diffused warm studio light from the front-left, gentle contact shadow under the podium
shots.background: warm cream #F2E9DD arched niche with soft rounded geometry
shots.props: one round matte cream podium disc
shots.textZone: upper area carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one warm brown pill label 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} displayed on a round matte cream podium inside a soft 3D arched niche. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on front view at eye-level, the product occupying 50-60% in the lower half. Upper area carries one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D and one warm brown pill label 「{callout_1}」 in #A9836B. Soft diffused warm studio light from the front-left, gentle contact shadow under the podium. Background warm cream #F2E9DD. The arched niche geometry fills the canvas around the podium. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy or treatment claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.displayName: 伏案久坐肩颈紧绷痛点
shots.intent: 放大久坐后肩颈酸胀紧绷的日常状态，唤起共鸣
shots.camera: close-up side profile of a generic person's neck-and-shoulder area, face not visible, documentary handheld feel
shots.lighting: slightly lower-key directional light from the upper right to feel heavy on the problem side
shots.background: relatable dim home desk context, kept candid and unpolished
shots.props: a desk edge and scattered papers, plus {product} resting small on the desk as the resolution hint, not covering the neck area
shots.textZone: one rounded caption strip at the bottom with short pain label 「{callout_1}」 and short solution label 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point shot. Close-up side profile of a generic person's neck-and-shoulder area with one hand pressing the tense neck, conveying post-work stiffness and fatigue; face not visible, cropped at the shoulders. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Documentary slightly handheld feel, lower-key directional light from the upper right. Background a relatable dim home desk context with a desk edge and scattered papers, kept candid; {product} resting small on the desk edge as the resolution hint. Bottom rounded caption strip with two short labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D. The subject area occupies 40-50% of the frame; the desk context fills the rest. Negative: no visible face, no medical or treatment claim text, no anatomy diagram text, no fabricated statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no distorted hands.

shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the head surface and subtle warm glow accents
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.textZone: two small annotation labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower corners

Two small annotation labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D at the lower corners. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated product parts, no medical claim text, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 12 张 U 型颈椎按摩仪爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字、模特身份、原文案、二维码与会员角标，产品一律以 {product} 占位；源图中缓解/治疗类功效文案一律未写实，缺失证据不在图内渲染、不虚构；品类按 taxonomy 判定为医药保健/按摩器械，不随源文件夹名（洗护）。
